text:
harini: heads-up: weird outage this morning. turns out my desktop aquariumheater was sitting on the same shelf as my router and the humidity + tiny salt spray corroded the ethernet plug. took forever to debug. pic: (image: aquarium-router-shelf.jpg) https://photos.example.com/aqua-hit
matt: wow that is impressively niche. aquarium: 1, home office: 0 :flushed:
isaac: salt spray? wild. did the cable look burned or just flaky connection?
harini: connector pins were dull and sticky. swapped cable + cleaned contacts and we're back. also moved the aquarium 3ft away.
nora: pro tip: silicone covers or short pigtail adapters help. or keep the router on a different shelf entirely.
infra-bot: diagnostic run by harini at 2187654330 -- pre-fix 1-min ping to staging avg=298ms loss=8%; post-fix avg=26ms loss=0%. logs posted to #eng-infra.
pepper-bot: fun fact: salt corrosion can form conductive paths across contacts. recommend periodic checks if you run aquaria near electronics. :nerd_face:
matt: we should start a "weird home culprits" wiki page. i'll draft a short doc and include aquarium, lava lamps, and haunted gnomes.
isaac: yes please. also add a short checklist: isolate router, use short pigtails, ferrite cores, and run a quick speedtest after any major decor changes.
harini: poll: show-and-tell "weird WFH culprits" tomorrow at 11am or 4pm? react :one: for 11am, :two: for 4pm. winners get a virtual cookie.
matt: :two:
isaac: :one:
nora: :two: (afternoon)
infra-bot: poll tally at 2187654348 -- :one: 1 vote, :two: 2 votes. 4pm wins.
harini: sweet. i'll post before/after pics of the connector and a short cleanup guide. also who will actually tidy their desk before posting? :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
participants poll replies: harini: yes, matt: maybe, isaac: no, nora: maybe
